content:
Alice Nguyen: FYI saw corrupt model outputs after a split safetensors upload this morning. workers served partially-written shard for a few minutes before warmup completed. not user-facing but alarming logs.
Ben Ortiz: oof. which storage backend?
Alice Nguyen: S3. upload process uploaded shards in parallel, then posted manifest. some workers tried to mmap shard before ingest finished.
Carla M.: classic read-while-writing. we need a clear activation protocol so runtime never opens a shard unless it's complete.
dev-bot: artifact-uploader: upload gpt-lite-split (8 shards) by @alice — manifest pending verification
Dan R: for POSIX we can do staging rename (write .part -> fsync -> rename). for object stores need manifest with per-shard checksums + sizes and an activation token.
Erin S: agree. proposal: manifest v2 fields: shards[{name, size, sha256, compressed}], activation_token, created_at. workers must validate header then optionally kick off background checksum.
Ben Ortiz: background checksum is important — full verify can be expensive on large tensors. lazy-verify: quick header parse then async full checksum; if mismatch evict and mark manifest invalid.
Carla M.: also add a lightweight per-shard readiness probe: upload a tiny "shard.ready" zero-byte object after shard completes. workers check for readiness if manifest lacks checksums (for old bundles).
Dan R: we should enforce: runtime only trusts manifest.json. if manifest v2 present, ignore stray shard files until manifest activation token is claimed via our lease service. prevents multiple controllers racing.
Erin S: lease claim flow: POST /leases/claim?token=... -> returns success and owner_id. TTL short. If claim fails, pick fallback model. if owner crashes lease expires.
Alice Nguyen: backwards compat: runtime falls back to current behavior if manifest has no checksums/activation token but log a warning. rollout flag to enable strict activation in 2 weeks.
Ben Ortiz: metrics: emit shard_activation_duration, shard_lazy_verify_failures, and shard_claim_conflicts. make alert for >1% verify failures.
Carla M.: CI: create a fuzz job in weights-ingest that writes truncated shards and verifies runtime rejects activation. also test S3 eventual-consistency edge cases.
dev-bot: ticket created WGT-4422: "manifest v2 + activation lease + lazy verify" assigned @carla @ben @alice
Alice Nguyen: thanks — prioritizing manifest schema + lease prototype. will keep implementation notes in this thread. ping if you see other corner cases. :pray:
